findings.documented: Append it as a query parameter: GET /v1/listings?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: API rejects query parameter with 401 Unauthorized and mandates X-API-Key HTTP header.
findings.how_found: Probed endpoints with ?api_key= query parameter vs X-API-Key header.
findings.impact: All client API requests fail if key is passed in URL query string.

findings.documented: Implied listings can be accessed with API key only.
findings.actual: Returns 401 Unauthorized with detail 'missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first'.
findings.how_found: Called GET /v1/listings with only X-API-Key header.
findings.impact: Listings data cannot be browsed without logging in first.

findings.documented: Returns field 'token' valid for 24 hours (expires_in: 86400). 'There is no refresh flow.'
findings.how_found: Inspected POST /auth/login response payload and tested POST /auth/refresh.
findings.impact: Client tokens expire after 15 minutes and require refresh flow implementation.

findings.actual: Singular path returns 404 Not Found. The working path is GET /v1/listings/{listing_id} (plural).
findings.how_found: Probed both singular and plural paths with sample listing ID.
findings.impact: Listing detail view fails if documented singular endpoint is called.

findings.how_found: Called endpoint with sample listing ID.
findings.impact: Similar listings feature must be implemented client-side.

findings.actual: All /v1/favourites paths return 404 Not Found. The actual working endpoint is /v1/saved.
findings.how_found: Systematic path scanning of candidate favourite/saved endpoints.
findings.impact: Saved listings fail unless routed to /v1/saved.

findings.documented: Pre-computed aggregates for the city at GET /v1/analytics/summary.
findings.impact: Insights screen metrics must be calculated from retrievable collections.

findings.actual: page parameter is ignored; pagination uses offset. limit is capped at 50.
findings.how_found: Tested page=1 vs page=2 (returned identical records) and limit=100 (returned 50).
findings.impact: Paging must use offset and cannot request batches larger than 50.

findings.documented: total is the exact number of records matching your filters. Read total, divide by limit, and request that many pages.
findings.actual: The total metadata field under-reports actual retrievable records across all endpoints: listings (reported 3643 vs retrievable 3800), rentals (1390 vs 1450), projects (422 vs 440).
findings.how_found: Paging past reported total until has_more === false.
findings.impact: Stopping at offset >= total truncates valid records (157 listings, 60 rentals, 18 projects lost).

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees.
findings.actual: Values are in Lakhs and Crores: values < 10 are in Crores, values >= 10 are in Lakhs.
findings.how_found: Distribution analysis and cross-record comparison against linked listing prices.
findings.impact: Project prices must be scaled (1e7 for < 10, 1e5 for >= 10) to obtain actual INR.

findings.documented: carpet_area and super_built_up_area are in square feet.
findings.actual: On website === 'magichomes', records with carpet_area < 300 (306 listings) are in square meters.
findings.how_found: Cross-portal duplicate matching against identical properties on other portals.
findings.impact: Calculating price per sqft without converting sqm (* 10.7639) inflates metrics tenfold.

findings.actual: Deposit values <= 10 (307 records) represent month multipliers, whereas larger values are direct INR.
findings.impact: Deposit multipliers must be multiplied by monthly rent to determine security deposit.

findings.documented: total_listings reports how many listings belong to this project.
findings.actual: total_listings tracks live linked listings (is_live === true), but is incorrect on exactly 95 projects.
findings.how_found: Full join of projects against live linked listings.
findings.impact: Cannot trust total_listings for live inventory; must aggregate from listings.

findings.documented: ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Listing posted_at lacks Z suffix or timezone offset, representing local Indian Standard Time (IST).
findings.how_found: Inspected posted_at across all 3,800 listing records.
findings.impact: Naive date parsers assume UTC or client timezone instead of IST (+05:30).

findings.actual: Exactly 28 listings describe physical impossibilities: negative price (7), floor > total_floors (7), super < carpet area (7), and swapped coordinates placing properties in the Arctic Ocean (7).
findings.how_found: Exhaustive field boundary and physical consistency audit.
findings.impact: Must be excluded from market metrics such as avg_price_per_sqft_2bhk.

findings.actual: 205 listings belong to a coordinated 7-broker syndicate, supported by shared contact numbers, repeated fictitious identities, copied inventory, systematic price undercutting, and corroborating scam-language evidence in 110 records.
findings.how_found: Graph network analysis of contact numbers, shared broker names, price distributions, and scam language.
findings.impact: Must be excluded from market metrics such as avg_price_per_sqft_2bhk.
